events.name: US ISM Manufacturing PMI
events.description: Tracks US factory activity via new orders, output and employment; a reading above 50 signals expansion.

events.name: China Caixin Manufacturing PMI
events.description: Measures manufacturing activity among small and mid-sized Chinese exporters, a key gauge of industrial momentum.

events.name: US JOLTS Job Openings
events.description: Counts unfilled US job vacancies, a key labour-demand indicator watched closely by the Federal Reserve.

events.name: US Trade Balance
events.description: Measures the gap between US exports and imports of goods and services for the month.

events.name: UK Services PMI
events.description: Tracks UK services-sector activity, the economy's dominant sector, via output, new business and employment.

events.name: Eurozone Services PMI
events.description: Measures Eurozone services-sector business activity, the bloc's largest sector and a core signal of growth.

events.name: US Initial Jobless Claims
events.description: Weekly count of new US unemployment benefit claims, an early signal of labour market stress.

events.name: Eurozone Retail Sales (M-o-M)
events.description: Tracks the monthly change in Eurozone retail spending, a key gauge of consumer demand and growth.

events.name: US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP)
events.description: Reports US job creation and the unemployment rate, the most closely watched US labour market indicator.

events.name: China Trade Balance
events.description: Measures the gap between China's exports and imports, reflecting global demand and trade tensions.
